cohort: 3,180 women with twin pregnancies undergoing caesarean section
finding: Twin growth discordance, especially with fetal growth restriction, was associated with an increased risk of postpartum haemorrhage in women with twin pregnancies undergoing caesarean section.
mod_finding: Twin growth discordance, especially with fetal growth restriction, was associated with an increased risk of postpartum haemorrhage in women with twin pregnancies undergoing caesarean section, and this association was more evident in patients with dichorionic twins.
